sn12.18:1.2: Atha kho Timbaruko paribbājako yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn12.18:1.3: sammodanīyam kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Timbaruko paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn12.18:2.1: kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃkatam sukhadukkhanti || ||
sn12.18:2.3: Kim pana bho Gotamā param-kataṃ sukhadukkhanti || ||
sn12.18:2.5: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃ-katañca paraṃ-katañca sukhadukkhanti || ||
sn12.18:2.7: Kim pana bho Gotama asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃ-kāram adhicca-samuppannam sukhadukkhanti || ||
sn12.18:2.9: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama natthi sukhadukkhanti || || 8
sn12.18:2.12: Tena hi bhavaṃ Gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti na passati || || 9
sn12.18:2.13: Na khvāhaṃ Timbaruka sukhadukkham na jānāmi na passāmi ||
sn12.18:3.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃkataṃ dukkhasukhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Mā hevam
sn12.18:3.3: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃ-katañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Mā hevam Timbarukā ti vadesi || ||
sn12.18:3.4: Kiṃ pana bho Gotama asayaṃkāram aparaṃ kāram adhicca-samuppannaṃ sukhadukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Mā hevaṃ Timbarukā ti vadesi || ||
sn12.18:3.5: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama natthi sukhadukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Na kho Timbaruka natthi sukhadukkham
sn12.18:3.7: Tena hi bhavaṃ Gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti iti puṭṭho samāno Na khvāham Timbaruka sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi na passāmi ||
sn12.18:3.10: Ācikkhatu ca me bhavaṃ Gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ
sn12.18:3.11: desetu ca me bhavaṃ Gotamo sukhadukkhan ti || || 11
sn12.18:4.1: Sā vedanā so vediyatīti kho Timbaruka ādito sato sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhanti || evam pāham na vadāmi || || 12
sn12.18:4.2: Aññā vedanā añño vediyatīti kho Timbaruka vedanābhitunnassa sato paraṃ kataṃ sukhadukkhanti || evam pahaṃ na vadāmi || || 13
sn12.18:4.3: Ete te Timbaruka ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn12.18:4.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.18:5.1: Evaṃ vutte Timbaruka paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.18:5.3: Esāham bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇam gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañca ||
sn12.18:5.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti || ||
